dct_creator_sm: Hives, Benjamin (University of British Columbia). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8874-8678
dct_description_sm:
This collection contains an analysis of the Canadian Community Health Survey Mental Health (2012). This includes both the original data as well as two value-added products (a sub-set of the data and r script for analysis).

Materials found in CCHS-MH folder are covered by the Statistics Canada Open License (Included within zip), all other materials are released under CC-BY.
